channel.ns1:summary: So glad you have found us! Welcome to Silly Stories for Kids — a podcast of wild adventures, made up on the spot and recorded so you and your family can join in the fun that goes on inside Sam’s brain. You could even be in a Silly Story by registering your family over on our website www.sillystoriesforkids.com We love kids and we love family. Our hope is that this podcast will be used in so many creative and amazing ways to bring joy to kids, expand imaginations and bring families together through laughter and crazy fun. Whether you choose to listen together at home, add some fun to your car trips, or take a moment to yourself while your kids listen, you can relax knowing they are enjoying some safe (but still crazy) screen-free fun. So, do you know what’s going to happen in today’s story? Neither do we! There’s only one way to find out… Okay, let’s go! Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.
channel.ns2:encoded:
So glad you have found us!


Welcome to Silly Stories for Kids — a podcast of wild adventures, made up on the spot and recorded so you and your family can join in the fun that goes on inside Sam’s brain. You could even be in a Silly Story by registering your family over on our website www.sillystoriesforkids.com


We love kids and we love family. Our hope is that this podcast will be used in so many creative and amazing ways to bring joy to kids, expand imaginations and bring families together through laughter and crazy fun.


Whether you choose to listen together at home, add some fun to your car trips, or take a moment to yourself while your kids listen, you can relax knowing they are enjoying some safe (but still crazy) screen-free fun.


So, do you know what’s going to happen in today’s story? Neither do we!

There’s only one way to find out…


Okay, let’s go!


Hosted on Acast. See acast.com/privacy for more information.

item.title: 📖 🌏 Special Episode - Pim Pim Reeds Rong - Where on Earth is Mum by Abbey Clerke 🌏 📖
item.description:
🎧✨ It's another episode of Pim Pim Reeds Rong! This time Pim Pim's "reading" Where on Earth is Mum? by Abbey Clerke 📖... except it somehow turns into an epic, around-the-world hunt for a puppy! 🐶 Desert pyramids 🏜️, penguin rides in Antarctica 🐧, a very confused shark 🦈, and a trip to the moon 🌙 — Pim Pim covers it all and gets basically NONE of it right! Spoiler: still no puppy by the end. 😂
🎉 Want to see Pim Pim's reading face for yourself? Catch the full video version over on Pim Pim and Friends 👉 PIM PIM AND FRIENDS
👉 Visit Our Website: www.sillystoriesforkids.com 👉 More Fun Here: https://linktr.ee/sillystoriesforkids 👉 Follow Us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/sillystoriesforkids
OK… Let's Go! 🚀😆

item.title: SPECIAL ANOUNCEMENT - SECOND GOLD COAST SHOW!!
item.description:
Hey families — I've got a super quick but super exciting announcement.
We just released a second show for the Silly Stories Spectacular on the Gold Coast — and it's already half sold. So if you've been on the waitlist, now's your time.
The second show is on August 8th at 4pm, and if you want in, head to sillystoriesforkids.com/tickets before they're gone.
You know what these live shows are like — original songs, big surprises, Pim Pim causing absolute chaos — and the Gold Coast families are not going to want to miss this one.
sillystoriesforkids.com/tickets — grab yours now.

item.title: 🍦❄️🌈 Whether the Weather Be Ice-cream 🌈❄️🍦
item.description:

item.title: 🎉 Pim Pim Reeds Rong - OK Let's Go by Silly Stories for Kids! 🎉
item.description:
🎉 A Super Special Bonus Episode! 🎉
This is a very special story from our brand-new video podcast, Pim Pim and Friends!
In this episode, Pim Pim looks through the pictures in our brand-new book, OK Let’s Go, and creates his very own silly adventure from what he sees. You never know where his imagination will take you!
📺 Want to watch the full video? Search for Pim Pim and Friends on Spotify.
📚 OK Let’s Go, written by Samuel Ramsden and illustrated by Abbey Clerke, is now available in Australia at sillystoriesforkids.com
